Cyber_805 employs automated tools and alerts to MES. It may just need to have the ability for operators to run an integrity check

I have received direction from Adam White that the product owner should run point on the product commitment.  Towards this end you will need to know what that means, what the expectations are, and who the points of contact are.

 

The overview:
 * You own the product
 * The commitments tie to the product
 * The commitments are owned in name for reporting purposes and visibility by Supervisor/Manager; Adam White and Mark Scussel in this case for Interface Products
 * SSW Commitments are coordinated by Linda Quattrucci
 * There is a commitment database here: [https://ora.ebnet.gdeb.com:4443/pls/APPL/!display.form?app_name=COMMITMENT%20REPORTING]
 * Commitment is abbreviated as CI

 

What is expected of you:
 # Read and understand the MDD
 # Leverage your SSW Commitment coordinator for questions on the CI process; leverage your Interface Lead also

 # Draft the commitment language using (a) examples, the (b) commitment form template, and (c) the schedule input from Interface Lead

 # Incorporate feedback and then route to SSW Commitment coordinator (Quattrucci)
 # Check implementation in the database
 # Maintain status weekly
 # Later at the appropriate time, close commitment with Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) provided to SSW Commitment coordinator (Quattrucci)

All,

There are requirements like the below example for sensor interfaces, but no corresponding interface requirements for the outputs. It seems that there were some in the TCS SSS, but they were removed in a prior release.

 

Example sensor requirement: The ESTCS shall [EST_637] receive EST lift/lower LPT inputs from the NIOU EST & AUX.

 

I also noticed some sensor interface requirements that may be missing from the PHC SSS.
 * 5VDC output to sensors
 * 28VAC inputs
 * LVDT excitation readback

 

Cory White is the delegate for the SC ICD while I am out, so please include him on emails/meetings on this topic.

 

Thanks,

 

Peter Baczyk
